3 brothers killed on this day in 1971
2022-12-15T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/3-brothers-killed-day-1971-3196331

Today is the 51st death anniversary of three brothers from the capital's Gopibagh who fought together in the Liberation War.

Shahjahan, Mulluk Jahan and Badiuzzaman were picked up from their home and brutally killed by the Pakistani occupation army on this day in 1971, just a day before victory.

They jointly participated in the guerilla fighting in Dhaka. After they returned home at night on December 15, a group of Razakars informed the Pakistani army about their location, said a press release.

Their bodies were later found among other martyrs at the Rayerbazar mass killing field on December 16. They were buried in Gopibagh Panchayat committee graveyard.
